errors.text_span: Тя е етикетирана, без да има определена мерна единица
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in two ways. First, the y-axis is not labeled with text. Second, the unit of measure is clearly percentage, as indicated by the '%' symbol on all data labels. The description contradicts itself, having just stated that the axis shows values in percentages.

errors.text_span: което показва, че скалата е линейна
errors.evidence: The description makes a faulty inference that the absence of a unit of measure indicates a linear scale. The linearity of the scale is determined by the equally spaced tick marks (0, 5, 10, 15...), not by the presence or absence of a label.
